units.title: SG-2.2 · Move game runtime from backend/game to top-level game/
Act: Move backend/game to top-level game/
Act: Fix .gitignore node_modules path for game/
Verify: game/ layout and content load unit tests

tests.id: layout.test.ts::game layout > has runtime dirs and no backend/game
tests.name: game layout has runtime dirs and no backend/game
tests.title: Game layout has runtime dirs and no backend/game
tests.scenario: Given the game/ package after the move, when the layout is checked, then src/engine, src/state, src/systems, src/content, content/worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml and tests exist and backend/game does not
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: layout.test.ts::game layout > loads the-boys-room from game/content
tests.name: game layout loads the-boys-room from game/content
tests.title: Loads the-boys-room world from game/content
tests.scenario: Given the the-boys-room world directory under game/content, when loadWorld is called, then it returns a defined world without throwing
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts tests/content.test.ts tests/loader.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/content.test.ts (4 tests)
tests.title: Existing content tests still pass from game/
tests.scenario: Given the moved game/ package, when the content tests run, then all 4 pass
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts tests/content.test.ts tests/loader.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/loader.test.ts (4 tests)
tests.title: Existing loader tests still pass from game/
tests.scenario: Given the moved game/ package, when the loader tests run, then all 4 pass
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.ts tests/content.test.ts tests/loader.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: .gitignore and module config path unit tests

tests.id: config.test.ts > repository gitignore > gitignore targets game/node_modules
tests.name: gitignore targets game/node_modules
tests.title: gitignore targets game/node_modules and no rule refers to backend/game
tests.scenario: Given the root .gitignore, When the ignore rules are read, Then game/node_modules/ is listed and no line includes backend/game
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/config.test.ts --testTimeout=30000

tests.id: config.test.ts > module config path globs > vitest and tsconfig use relative globs
tests.name: vitest and tsconfig use relative globs
tests.title: vitest and tsconfig use relative globs
tests.scenario: Given game/vitest.config.ts and game/tsconfig.json, When they are read, Then vitest contains tests/**/*.test.ts and tsconfig include equals ["src","tests"]
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/config.test.ts --testTimeout=30000
tests.detail: 2 of 2 tests in tests/config.test.ts passed (vitest 2.1.9, 2ms total)
